basic_info.description: Updated home a half block from Dolores Park! Renovated for modern living, this classic San Francisco flat retains its original charm with many period details. Updates include an eat-in kitchen, in-unit laundry, and a modern hall bath with walk-in shower. The perfect home for today's lifestyle and move-in ready. Assigned storage space is included, along with space for bikes. Seismically retrofitted to meet modern requirements. Make this tremendous Mission Dolores location yours and enjoy some of San Francisco's best cafes, restaurants, and shopping along 18th Street and the Valencia Corridor. Walk Score 98!
